svg.title: Workite Distributed Architecture
svg.desc: Workite architecture with a stateless Gateway tier, a single-Raft-group Placement Driver control plane, and a multi-Raft-group Broker data plane.
svg.text: Stateless routing is decoupled from the control plane; PD uses one metadata Raft group, while Brokers host an independent Raft group per partition
Any instance can accept traffic; only routing topology is cached locally
One replicated state machine stores all control-plane metadata
Leader, voter, learner, and health status
Scale, catch-up, promotion, and leader transfer
Each partition is an independent Raft group with isolated election, replication, and state
Broker register / renew · replica role and progress
Role placement is illustrative: PD has one Raft group; every Broker partition elects independently, and leaders can move between Brokers.
